title: Start / resume sessions
summary: Launch --machine takes a registered Machine id (`yoke machine list`); a registered name or relay hostname resolves only when exactly one live Machine carries it. Retired Machines never match. Zero or several matches refuse machine_unresolved: several list each live candidate id with its name and last_seen_at, and a value naming a test machine adds that test machines are reached through their QA lease and points to the Machine id the install registered, listed by `yoke machine list` on the server it connected to.
